people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
translations.asv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt understand hereafter.
